experiment: 01 only: nested translation count at R4, frozen before fits
population: All ten beta, 8192 TRAIN + 8192 TEST, 163840 distinct immutable seed/id pairs. TEST held out of these fits but previously inspected. No additional simulations.
train: Original center (10,10,10) plus seven distinct uniformly sampled periodic origins excluding the original, keyed PCG64 [103071,beta-index,chain_seed,chain_id]. Per-parent permutation of eight slot indices, drawn from same keyed Generator after offsets; residual modulo K for K=1,4,8. Stored common ordered parent-major bank; same stock shuffle=100000, batch=500, 65536 rows=131x500+36/epoch. All parents appear each epoch. Random within-batch negative pairs may share parent: probability 7/65535 per negative, identical scheduling law and seed per arm. Distinct translations not independent parents.
fits: 90 independent stock fits on one H100, up to eight concurrent, no retry/abort siblings on NaN. All start at update zero; five checkpoints from each single trajectory. Stock optimiser, Adam .009, encoder, critic, stochastic objective and original settings; 76 full epochs. One fixed orientation with shell translated with center. No adaptive depth; no reserved TRAIN-only validation fold. Report last-rung TRAIN change descriptively, not a plateau certificate.
evaluation: Frozen matching encoder and critic at each exact update; snapshot training weights + stock global_step, score only after training; never change training RNG or expose training to TEST. Original immutable anchor/order at all 8192 TEST parents; one shared relaxed draw per parent for real and null, one finite stock score matrix per batch, masks diagonal vs prior fixed derangement (PCG64 [771904,b,j]). Evaluation RNG 440311+b for all arms/depths/seeds. TFP 0.25 float32 is primary; stable centered float64 logsumexp and paired diagonal-minus-permuted score on same matrix cross-check. Flag/exclude nonfinite, ceiling violations (>ln(batch)+1e-5) or absolute stock/ref discrepancy >0.001 nat per batch from physical decision; retain raw outputs and never replace a primary result by the diagnostic. Hard counts threshold at 0.5, entropy in bits.
estimand: Primary per beta and seed: D=(true-shuffled gain at K8)-(true-shuffled gain at K1), final 10032 only. Also report absolute K8 plus K4 saturation and all checkpoints. Identical disjoint 16x500+192 parent batches; differences paired *within batch before* uncertainty. Weighted mean, se=sqrt(17/16*sum(w_j^2*(x_j-mean)^2)), t16 pointwise 95% interval. Seeds are fitting variability on reused parents, not independent test cohorts. Do not select seed/temperature/depth on TEST.
decision: Predeclared cold endpoint beta 3.05: physical support only when each of the three seeds has valid final K1/K8, lower pointwise CI >0.01 nat for both absolute K8 and paired D, and no beta-zero seed lower CI exceeds 0.01 for either measure. Missing cold/control comparisons or wide intervals => not established. No new phase claim. Show seed range, depth contrast, K8-K4 and actual coverage independently of decision.
outputs: Stock TRAIN curves, held ladder gains/D separately, heatmap distinguishing complete/partial/nonfinite/unrun and numerically invalid, signed same-scale hot/cold filters, hard code usage/entropy, per-cell and per-pair CSVs, raw stock checkpoint weights and batch scores, actual optimizer steps and examples. No 02.
